# Rear differential breather extension mod

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Locate, unscrew, and replace the rear differential breather fitting with a new one connected via vacuum hose. [t626]

[Partial] Extend or modify the rear differential vent tube behind the tail light to direct airflow away from mud traps. [t626]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Locate the breather on the right hand rear axle tube.
2. Wipe any dirt or debris from around the breather cap.
3. Unscrew the old fitting and discard it.
4. Apply antizeize or thread sealant to the threads of Nissan Part Number 38323-C601A.
5. Screw the new fitting into the axle tube by hand until several threads are engaged.
6. Guide the vacuum tube past the right taillight, across the chassis, then forward to the diff nipple.
7. Ensure the routed hose stays away from the exhaust system and moving parts while leaving slack for articulation.
8. Place a clamp over the end of the tube where it meets the nipple.
9. Push the tube onto the nipple until seated against the hex head, then tighten the clamp.
10. Pull up any excess tube behind the tail light to form a short loop.
11. [Partial] Cut the tube so that the filter will fit inside the void behind the light.
12. Slip another clamp on the cut end of the tube.
13. Inset the small fuel or aquarium filter into the tubing and tighten its clamp.
14. Reinstall the tail light.

_Procedure reported by [t626]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-rear-diff-breather-extension-mod.9486/>_

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t626] [Partial]</summary>

1. Locate the rear differential vent tube positioned behind the tail light assembly.
2. [Partial] Extend or modify the existing breather line to direct airflow away from mud traps.

</details>

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Ensure the loop behind the tail light is short enough so the filter rides in the void. [t626]
- Note that some owners prefer a U-shaped configuration facing downward for drainage. [t626]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Failing to account for the slight upward angle of the tube which can trap water or mud. [t626]
- Spraying engine wash directly into an unfiltered breather opening without realizing it is there. [t626]
